---
title: What the plain route stamps on Julia cells
engine: julia
---

A prose block first, so the raw notebook index and the code-cell ordinal differ.

```{julia}
using Base64
png = base64decode("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==")
display(MIME("image/png"), png)
```

Between the cells.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: A labeled figure.
display(MIME("image/png"), png)
```

```{julia}
display(MIME("image/png"), png)
display(MIME("image/png"), png)
```

```{julia}
println("printed before the figure")
display(MIME("image/png"), png)
```

```{julia}
1 + 1
```
